# Getting Started

## Loading In 

```{r}
library(flowWorkspace)
library(Luciernaga)
library(Coereba)
library(flowGate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
TheseScripts <- list.files("R", pattern=".R", full.names=TRUE)
walk(.x=TheseScripts, .f=source)
```

```{r}
Folder <- "PMA_Antibody"
Subset <- "CD8"

StorageLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder, Subset)

PaCMAPPath <- file.path(StorageLocation, "PaCMAP")

OutpathLocation <- file.path(PaCMAPPath, "Islands")
if(!dir.exists(OutpathLocation)){dir.create(OutpathLocation)}
```

```{r}
fcs_files <- list.files(PaCMAPPath, pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)
IslandsSet <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files, truncate_max_range = FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
IslandsGS <- GatingSet(IslandsSet)
```

```{r}
#| label: "Biexponential Transformation"
#| message: false
Markers <- colnames(IslandsGS)
KeptMarkers <- Markers[-grep("Time|FS|SC|SS|Original|-W$|-H$|AF|Coereba|PaCMAP", Markers)]
MarkersForToday <- KeptMarkers

Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=4194304,
     pos=5.62, neg=1, widthBasis=-1000)
TransformList <- transformerList(KeptMarkers, Biexponential)

IslandsGS <- transform(IslandsGS, TransformList)
colnames(IslandsGS)
```

```{r}
ggcyto(IslandsGS[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="BV480-A", y="PE-Vio770-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

ggcyto(IslandsGS[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="PaCMAP_1", y="PaCMAP_2")) + geom_hex(bins=180)
```

## Enumeration

```{r}

RapidFire <- function(IslandsSet, x, OutputLocation, Subset){

Index <- x

TheData <- Coereba::Coereba_FCS_Reversal(Coereba=IslandsSet[[Index]])

#print(TheData)

FuckingMetadata <- TheData |>
     dplyr::select("bid", "ptype", "infant_sex", "Experiment", "Condition") |> unique()
rownames(FuckingMetadata) <- NULL

Example <- cytoframe_to_flowFrame(IslandsSet[[1]])
TheColumns <- flowWorkspace::markernames(Example)
Fluorophore <- names(TheColumns)
Fluorophore <- gsub("-A", "", Fluorophore)
ThePanel <- data.frame(Fluorophore, check.names=FALSE)
ThePanel <- ThePanel |> 
  mutate(Fluorophore = case_when(
    Fluorophore == "PE-Vio770" ~ "PE-Vio 770",
    Fluorophore == "PE-Dazzle594" ~ "PE-Dazzle 594",
    TRUE ~ Fluorophore
  ))
ThePanel <- ThePanel |>  mutate(
    Detector = map_chr(Fluorophore, \(f) Luciernaga::DetectorGuess(x = f, NumberDetectors = 64)))
ThePanel <- ThePanel |> mutate(Marker = TheColumns)
DetectorOrder <- c("UV1", "UV2", "UV3", "UVx <- Index[1]4", "UV5", "UV6", "UV7", "UV8",
               "UV9", "UV10", "UV11", "UV12", "UV13", "UV14", "UV15", "UV16",
               "V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8",
               "V9", "V10", "V11","V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16",
               "B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", "B7", "B8",
               "B9", "B10", "B11", "B12", "B13", "B14",
               "YG1", "YG2", "YG3", "YG4", "YG5", "YG6", "YG7", "YG8", "YG9", "YG10",
               "R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6", "R7", "R8")
ThePanel$Detector <- factor(ThePanel$Detector, levels=DetectorOrder)
ThePanel <- ThePanel |> arrange(Detector) |> select(-Detector)

TheBioconductor <- Coereba_Processing(x=TheData,
 panel=ThePanel, themetadata=FuckingMetadata,
 metadata_columns=c("bid", "ptype", "infant_sex", "Experiment", "Condition"),
 SpecimenVariable="bid")

Data <- Coereba_MarkerExpressions(x=TheBioconductor, returnType="All", theassay="ratios")

TheCSV <- paste0(Subset, "_", Index, "_MarkerExpressions.csv")
StoreHere <- file.path(OutputLocation, TheCSV)

write.csv(Data, StoreHere, row.names=FALSE)

shape_ptype <- c("HU" = 22, "HEU-lo" = 21, "HEU-hi" = 21)
fill_ptype <- c("HU" = "white", "HEU-lo" = "darkgray", "HEU-hi" = "black")

Data$ptype <- factor(Data$ptype, levels=c("HU", "HEU-lo", "HEU-hi"))

ThisFilesName <- paste0(Subset, "_", Index, "_PMA")

ThePlot <- Utility_MarkerPlots(data=Data, myfactor="ptype", shape_palette = shape_ptype, fill_palette = fill_ptype, panel=ThePanel, XAxisLevels=NULL, cex=0.5, size =1, corral.width = 0.5, MarkerName="Marker", savePlot = TRUE, filename = ThisFilesName, style="separate", outpath = OutputLocation, width=18)

}
```

```{r}
Index <- 1:length(IslandsSet)

# x <- Index[1]

# devtools::document("/home/david/Documents/Coereba")

walk(.f=RapidFire, .x=Index, IslandsSet=IslandsSet, OutputLocation=OutpathLocation, Subset=Subset)
```
